purpose: Audit whether a bounded, understandable user strategy builder can express strategies with useful historical investment performance under the game's execution constraints.
scope: Retrospective diagnostic, NOT a fresh holdout, live alpha claim, user study, game modification or deployment. All 2014-2023 history has prior analysis exposure.

selection.primary_windows: First eligible January start each year, exactly 240 weekdays, first and last turn market-open, all 117 supplied stocks subject to contemporaneous eligibility.
selection.secondary_windows: First eligible start each calendar quarter; overlapping windows are descriptive, never independent replications.
selection.top_two: Choose only from the 14 core candidates, by development annual-window median net return at 10 bps per side, then median drawdown (less negative preferred), then identifier. Freeze before validation/confirmation summaries.

builder_boundary.assets: Supplied stock universe and cash only; no shorting or leverage.
builder_boundary.observability: Prices and volumes through current close, known holdings/cash/calendar; 60 observed bars minimum. Original historical universe and adjustment-vintage limitations remain.
builder_boundary.normalization: Same-date cross-sectional percentile ranks; no full-period fitted transform.

ridge.features: Six primitive features, cross-sectional ranks centered at zero; missing ranks become zero.
ridge.refit: Every January, trailing three calendar years, only labels whose exit date is strictly before the refit date.
ridge.target: Next market open to open after 1 or 20 market-session intervals, minus matching KOSPI open return.
ridge.penalty: mean squared error + 0.1 * squared coefficient norm; centered intercept, deterministic closed-form fit.

builder_boundary.portfolio: Top 10, initial equal cash allocation, held names retain quantities. Cash from exits funds entrants. Ties prefer incumbents then asset id.
builder_boundary.additional_core_candidates: Momentum60 and blend on five-turn policy with KOSPI close > trailing MA60 exposure gate; otherwise sell tradable holdings and remain in cash.
builder_boundary.execution: Decide after close, next market open fill, same integer quantities, fixed cash budgets, buy ceil/sell floor and missing-price/rejection rules as runtime fillOpenOrder. Existing delisting convention, close valuation, no final-day new orders.
builder_boundary.diagnostics: Existing immutable LightGBM walk-forward signals with daily 1, daily 10, and every-20-turn 10 replacement policies; diagnostic policies are not deployable artifacts.
builder_boundary.controls: Cash, initial equal-cash buy-and-hold of all eligible stocks, KOSPI index return (non-tradable reference), ten fixed-seed random rankings with both core execution policies.

cost_and_capital.cost_interpretation: 10 bps per side is a hypothetical aggregate cost stress, not a representation of legal/current brokerage fees or taxes.

robustness.monthly_diagnostics: Twelve 20-turn investment returns and win counts versus existing quant; no prizes added to investment performance.
robustness.cashflow_stress: Selected strategies, normal debt 100m, 50m starting assets. Game salary minus default living costs (+2.2m) on turns 21,41,...,221; attempt ceil(100m/12) repayment at turns 20,40,...,240. Keep one remaining installment in cash, plan liquidation three turns before deadline; clip repayments to cash and remaining debt. No side jobs, random events, trust/stress termination or prize flows. Report as partial economic stress, NOT full-game victory.
robustness.accessibility: Executable strategy-card reproducibility and neighborhood stability only; novice usability/discoverability requires a later human study.

provisional_practical_gate.note: Engineering screen fixed before new outcomes; not a user-approved return promise or statistical alpha certification.
provisional_practical_gate.primary_population: Five annual windows starting 2019-2023, selected strategies only, 50m, 10 bps per side.
provisional_practical_gate.neighbors: Both preregistered neighboring configurations have positive pooled 2019-2023 median return at 10 bps.
provisional_practical_gate.capital: All three additional starting capitals have positive pooled median return at 10 bps.
provisional_practical_gate.full_validation: Impossible to certify fresh generalization or user accessibility in this retrospective automated audit, even if practical screen passes.

required_checks: Preserve hashes of original input, models and deployable signals.
Exactly reproduce saved 2022-2023 baseline with the runtime replay before interpreting new results.
Check research replay against runtime replay for existing quant, including costs and small capital.
Suffix perturbation leaves earlier constructed features and decisions unchanged.
Ridge training exit dates are strictly earlier than forecast vintage.
Orders never use same-day execution after a close decision; no negative cash or short positions.
External cash flows are excluded with the runtime time-weighted return helper.
Do not modify live DB, services, deployed model or original prototype.
